defaultPrompt: Full Jira task lifecycle manager for the ByteDesk Platform (BDP) project.
Keep Codex/Grok skill state (.agents/skills) in parity with the canonical Claude skills (.claude/skills).
Front-door administrator for the goal pipeline.
Plan a multi-task initiative as a Jira Epic whose child Tasks are each a runnable goal.
Run a planning session that turns a fuzzy intent into a self-contained, goal-based spec saved at docs/goals/<theme>.md, then exits plan mode by handing off a runnable `/goal docs/goals/<theme>.md`.
Execute goal batches through run-goals — validate manifests, then drain the plan sequentially inline via /goal handoffs (exit 2 until each goal completes).
